title: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract
summary: Resolve locale, currency, tax, timezone and residency policy context without owning tax calculation or translation.

criteria: A resolution answers, for one tenant and one subject, the applicable jurisdiction together with its locale, currency, tax regime reference, timezone and residency constraints as one coherent policy context.
The resolved policy context is a lookup answer, not a computation: tax calculation stays with the computation authority and translation stays with the i18n authority.
Resolution is default-deny: when no jurisdiction rule matches, the answer is an explicit unresolved result rather than a silent fallback to a default country or currency.
A cross-jurisdiction request is answered only when the requested jurisdiction is explicitly in scope for that tenant; otherwise it is refused rather than approximated.
The contract exposes a read-only query layer over declared jurisdiction rules; it never writes a business record and never performs a business action.
residency constraints are returned as policy inputs, and the enforcement decision on those constraints stays with policy-decision-point-contract.

risks.desc: Falling back to a default country, currency or timezone when no jurisdiction matches would silently apply the wrong legal and monetary context to a real transaction.
risks.mitigation: Fix resolution at default-deny with an explicit unresolved result and prove the refusal with a dedicated negative rather than assuming a default.

risks.desc: Returning residency constraints that are stale or scoped to the wrong tenant would let data be processed in a jurisdiction that forbids it.
risks.mitigation: Scope every resolution to one tenant, version rules by effective date and keep residency enforcement with the PDP under a fixed negative-test axis.

risks.desc: Resolving a historical request against the current rule version would make an earlier invoice, tax context or residency answer unreproducible.
risks.mitigation: Bind every resolution to an effective date and a rule version, keep rules append-only and require a replay comparison as evidence.

risks.desc: A jurisdiction resolver could be misread as authority over tax calculation, translation or residency enforcement.
risks.mitigation: Keep the tax calculation, translation and enforcement exclusions explicit in every phase, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: The resolver maps a tenant, a subject and an effective date to one jurisdiction with its locale, currency, tax regime reference, timezone and residency constraints.
Girdi is a tenant scope plus a subject and an effective date; çıktı is a coherent policy context, or an explicit unresolved result under default-deny.
The surface is a read-only query layer over declared jurisdiction rules; it never writes a business record and never performs a business action.
A cross-jurisdiction request is answered only inside the tenant's declared jurisdiction scope, so an out-of-scope request is refused rather than approximated.
Kapsam sınırı gereği tax calculation stays with the computation authority, translation stays with the i18n authority and residency enforcement stays with the PDP.
featureDefs.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/featureDefs: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
featureDefs.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: tenant and effective-date scoped jurisdiction resolution returning locale, currency, tax regime reference, timezone and residency, default-deny unresolved results, read-only query layer. Exclude tax calculation, translation and residency enforcement. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: Default-deny is the primary control: an unmatched jurisdiction returns an explicit unresolved result, so a missing rule can never become an accidental legal or monetary context.
Every resolution is bound to one tenant, so a cross-tenant jurisdiction read is refused rather than filtered, which preserves izolasyon.
residency constraints are returned as policy inputs and enforced by the PDP, which keeps the enforcement boundary single-owner and auditable.
The query layer has no ambient erişim and no write path: it reads only declared jurisdiction rules, which keeps least privilege enforceable.
A jurisdiction answer influences money and legal exposure, so the rule version and effective date are recorded with every resolution as an auditable denetim triple.
security.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/security: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
security.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: default-deny unresolved answers, tenant-bound resolution, PDP-owned residency enforcement, read-only least-privilege query layer, versioned auditable answers. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one typed resolution katman for every consumer rather than a per-domain jurisdiction lookup, so the policy context cannot diverge between callers.
Rule matching and effective-date selection stay pure functions with low cyclomatic complexity, testable without a datastore.
Resolution and enforcement stay separated; ölü kod and speculative per-country resolvers are refused, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: The declared jurisdiction rule set is closed and versioned, so adding a jurisdiction is a reviewed change rather than something a query can introduce.
Least ayrıcalık applies to the query layer: it may read declared rules and tenant scope and nothing else, and no secret is reachable from a resolution path.
Resolution cost is bounded per tenant with rate limits, so a crafted enumeration of jurisdictions cannot be used to map another tenant's declared scope.
The resolution yüzey stays kapalı: the query layer has no egress to an external geo or tax feed at request time, so a jurisdiction answer cannot be influenced by an outside service mid-resolution.
securityOptimization.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: closed versioned rule set, least-privilege read-only query path, per-tenant rate limits against scope enumeration. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for a single jurisdiction resolution on a representative rule set; no measurement is claimed here.
Resolution is expected on transactional paths, so the budget treats it as a hot lookup and allows caching keyed by tenant, subject class, effective date and rule version.
Rule lookup must avoid N+1 access; the applicable rule set is fetched once per resolution rather than once per returned policy field.
performance.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 resolution budget, version-keyed caching, N+1-free rule lookup. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client consumes a resolved policy context; a cihaz may not infer a jurisdiction from its own locale or network position and submit it as authoritative.
An offline client displays the last synchronised policy context as stale together with its rule version, rather than re-deriving a currency or timezone on device.
No mobile jurisdiction administration surface is introduced here; rendering a policy context stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: server-authoritative policy context, stale offline display with rule version, no device-side jurisdiction inference. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future jurisdiction administration surface must present the resolved locale, currency, timezone and residency constraints as keyboard navigable content with a visible odak ring at the AAA kontrast threshold.
An unresolved jurisdiction result must be announced through an aria live region naming what was requested and that no rule matched, rather than rendering a blank context.
This contract defines resolution semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: keyboard-navigable policy context presentation, announced unresolved results, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; any future Kubernetes topology for a resolution service remains human-developer work.
Activating a new jurisdiction rule version is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a container rebuild; rollback returns to the previous rule version.

Undoing this jurisdiction shard reverts the contract file and re-derives the projections built from it; no resolved locale, currency or residency value in any store changes, runtimeDataImpact remains none and NO-GO remains in place.
deployment.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, rule version activation as an approved data change, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A jurisdiction rule change olay may notify downstream consumers to re-resolve, but this contract never performs a business action of its own on that event.
A re-resolution that triggers another downstream re-resolution forms a chain that stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a rule change cannot cascade without bound.
Re-delivering the same rule change event for the same rule version must be idempotent, and activating a new rule version always requires an explicit onay.
eca.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: rule-change events without acting, depth-bounded re-resolution chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated rule activation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay forbidden actions ve yasak kalır.

AI cannot activate a jurisdiction rule version, cannot widen a tenant's declared jurisdiction scope and cannot substitute a fallback for an unresolved result; each of those needs insan onayı, and a residency change additionally requires a step-up review.

Any jurisdiction claim reaching the lane as sub_prompt is untrusted, the kill switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 scope or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from activating rule versions, widening jurisdiction scope or substituting fallbacks, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases resolve a tenant and subject to a jurisdiction and assert locale, currency, tax regime reference, timezone and residency are returned together, as unit and integration matrices.
Planned negatives prove an unmatched request returns an explicit unresolved result under default-deny rather than a fallback country or currency.
Planned negatives prove a cross-jurisdiction request outside the tenant's declared scope and a cross-tenant read are both refused.
Planned boundary cases prove no tax amount is computed and no translated string is returned, keeping tax calculation and translation outside.
A result is written down only once a human-approved run has truly executed, and the planned resolution cases above never count as green by themselves.
testing.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: coherent policy context positives, default-deny unresolved negatives, cross-jurisdiction and cross-tenant negatives, tax and translation boundary cases. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is modeled by binding every resolution to one tenant and refusing a cross-jurisdiction request outside the declared scope.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by declaring default-deny, effective-date versioning and the enforcement exclusion up front, so a missing rule cannot degrade into a permissive default.
OWASP A09 security logging failures is modeled by recording the rule version and effective date with every resolution so a legal or monetary answer stays reconstructable.

Girdi doğrulama applies to every resolution request: tenant, subject class and effective date are validated before any rule lookup, and each resolution or refusal leaves a denetim izi carrying the rule version.
owasp.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via tenant-bound scoped resolution, A04 via default-deny and versioned design, A09 via versioned resolution logging. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-bayraklari with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-jurisdiction] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a resolution touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a rule change arrives as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor policy-decision-point-contract ends 2028-04-30, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.
dependsOn stays exactly k-tenancy and policy-decision-point-contract, and no parent bağımlılık edge is inherited.
Scope stays inside the resolution layer: tax calculation, translation and residency enforcement all stay outside.
integration.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-bayraklari to k-jurisdiction, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir a resolved policy context through this contract and may not maintain its own country table or reach a doğrudan tablo for jurisdiction rules.
A consumer must carry the rule version and effective date alongside any stored jurisdiction-dependent value, so a later audit can tell which context produced it.
Computing a tax amount belongs to the computation authority and enforcing residency belongs to the PDP; this contract resolves context only.
moduleUsage.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: resolver-mediated policy context without local country tables or direct table reads, rule version carried with stored values, excluded computation and enforcement authority. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: residency constraints are the contract's most compliance-sensitive output, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir.
A resolution log names a tenant and a subject class rather than a person where possible, and its saklama süresi is bounded by the shortest retention among its inputs.
Jurisdiction rules and their effective-date ranges are retained append-only so a historical legal context stays explainable, and stored rules evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: residency as compliance-sensitive output, minimised bounded-retention resolution logs, append-only rule history and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrics include resolution latency percentiles, unresolved-result rates by request kind and refused cross-jurisdiction counts on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the jurisdiction id, rule version and effective date; subject identifiers and residency payloads are redacted and never become metric labels.

Alerts cover an unresolved-rate spike after a rule change, a surge of cross-jurisdiction refusals and any resolution served from an expired rule version; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: resolution and unresolved SLIs, redacted rule-scoped traces, unresolved-spike and expired-version alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The primary failure mode is an unreachable rule store during resolution; the resolver degrades to an explicit unresolved result, never to a cached default jurisdiction.

Resolution is idempotent by construction: the same tenant, subject and effective date against the same rule version returns the same policy context, so a retry with bounded backoff cannot drift the answer.
A repeatedly failing rule activation is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than retried forever, and a circuit breaker protects the shared resolver.
reliability.notes: jurisdiction-resolution-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Jurisdiction Resolution Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: fail-closed unresolved answer on store failure, idempotent resolution with bounded retry, dead-letter routing and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
